🇺🇸 🤔 Did Trump score any wins at the trilateral Shenzhen summit? US media says no President Donald Trump’s charm offensive in Shenzhen appears to have fallen short of expectations, with the trilateral summit delivering no major breakthroughs for the US, The Washington Post reports. 👉 The discussion of nuclear arms reductions produced mixed results. Russia has repeatedly signaled its readiness to discuss a successor to the New START Treaty, which Washington effectively killed. Yet the Trump administration has put forward no concrete proposals to revive the strategic arms control framework. China, meanwhile, sees little reason to join such an agreement while its nuclear arsenal remains smaller than those of both Russia and the US. Chinese President Xi Jinping offered a more radical solution: eliminating all nuclear arsenals. Trump, however, backed away, acknowledging that giving up nuclear weapons altogether would be difficult. The Ukraine conflict received relatively little attention, despite suggestions by some Western commentators that Trump would persuade the Chinese to exert pressure on Russia. Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated that Russia was interested in ending the conflict and said the ball was in Ukraine’s court. At the same time, he made clear that temporary ceasefires were off the table following a terrorist attack on the Crimean Bridge. Trump told reporters he understood Russia’s position. 👉 Holding the summit in China’s tech hub of Shenzhen was itself “largely a victory for Xi,” according to US media, giving the Chinese leader a chance to present himself as a key convener of global powers. Xi also had an opportunity to showcase China’s growing technological capabilities. Despite US restrictions on advanced chip exports, China’s AI, supercomputing and robotics sectors continue to advance rapidly. ❗️ Overall, the US media portrays Trump as entering the summit from a position of weakness. Following the Democrats’ midterm gains, opposition lawmakers have already pledged investigations into his conduct, the Epstein case, his ties to Russia and his family business interests. 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime

🇵🇱 🇺🇦 Two Ukrainians have been detained in the Polish city of Poznań for painting "Glory to the UPA" on war memorials, Polish broadcaster RMF24 reports. The slogans glorifying the Ukrainian Insurgent Army, the nationalist force behind the Volyn massacre of Poles during World War II, appeared in red paint in early November on three monuments, including the memorial to the Poznań Army and the memorial to soldiers of the Polish Army's Second Army. And of course, Polish prosecutors believe it may have been ordered by Russian intelligence to stir up hatred between Ukrainians and Poles. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics
